| Evidence | Location | What it supports | What it does not support |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Final receipt manifest | [`FINAL_RESULTS_RECEIPTS.json`](FINAL_RESULTS_RECEIPTS.json) | Exact paths, SHA-256 digests, roles, denominators, and exclusions for the frozen result set | External identity or legal correctness |
| One-page result | [`../../relaybench/PUBLIC_RESULTS.md`](../../relaybench/PUBLIC_RESULTS.md) | Human-readable bounded synthesis | Official Harvey leaderboard status or population causality |
| Seven complete panel files | [`../../relaybench/results/`](../../relaybench/results/) | Per-model, per-task paired quality, safety, and operational records | Generalization beyond the frozen panel |
| Invalid-attempt ledger | [`../../relaybench/results/pre-v9-attempt-ledger-2026-08-24.json`](../../relaybench/results/pre-v9-attempt-ledger-2026-08-24.json) | Failed, partial, malformed, and invalid routes retained before final panels | Treatment estimates |
| DeepSeek breadth expansion | [`../../relaybench/results/deepseek-v9-14-task-expansion-2026-08-25.json`](../../relaybench/results/deepseek-v9-14-task-expansion-2026-08-25.json) | Secondary task-breadth and floor-sensitivity evidence | A seven-model breadth result |
| Frozen aggregate table | [`tables/final-panel.md`](tables/final-panel.md) | ARA-readable transcription of primary quality, safety, and scope totals | New evidence beyond the receipt manifest |
| Publication figure pointer | [`figures/public-result.md`](figures/public-result.md) | Binds the communication visual to its source and claim boundary | Independent empirical evidence |

Only the seven complete panels named in the receipt manifest enter the 126-pair aggregate. Kimi, Phase Zero test doubles, route calibrations, and invalid attempts remain retained but excluded. Further runs belong to a new preregistered study and cannot silently update this frozen result.

Do not include raw private prompts, transcripts, credentials, or undisclosed Harvey materials in this public artifact. Store only the minimum permitted evidence needed to reproduce the stated claim boundary.

Run `python3 ../src/execution/verify_receipts.py` from this directory, or `python3 src/execution/verify_receipts.py` from the ARA root. The verifier resolves every admitted and secondary result path relative to `FINAL_RESULTS_RECEIPTS.json`, recomputes SHA-256, and fails closed on missing or mismatched files.
